full_details: Morning prayer at St Helen's ran to two turns of the glass. In the porch Sir John Spencer went toward Crosby Place without a sword-bearer. Gillis Verbeke said Norwich, and no other town. The loaf was a thumb short, and a penny. Mistress Ansell's ink is twopence the horn. You did not buy any. After dinner you answered Anne. The wash stands at fourpence a week, already paid. The Christmas money is so much for the house, so much for the shop's debts, and so much she may spend without writing first. You did not name the figures. You asked after the children's string-and-spool engine. A struck scrap, "You might have asked me," stayed off the sheet. The sheet has not gone. It waits for the carrier of the fourth. Before candles you opened both locks. You wrote what is spoken for, and you did not write a total. The memo was that money feels freer before it is counted.
one_sentence: You stood in the south porch after two glasses, wrote Anne, and counted what was already promised.
title: Wrote Anne and opened the coffer
